notes: Fiche communautaire recensee par Porsche Fanatics pour une petite patte d'interrupteur de console centrale 964/993, devenue cassante avec l'age selon l'auteur. La licence est encore non verifiee; aucun fichier n'est copie ici et aucune cote d'interface, unite, mesure, tolerance ou preuve d'ajustement n'est publiee dans le registre. Obtenir le fichier et les droits aupres de la source primaire, puis mesurer la console de la variante exacte avant toute utilisation. Candidat interieur non critique, pas une piece declaree ajustee ou testee. 2026-10-15: same asset as SRC-RENN3D-CONSOLE-SWITCH-TAB-REPAIR, whose secondary archive declares CC-BY without a version; the licence string here now records that declaration. On 2026-10-15 the original Printables page (model 1369571) was not readable: printables.com/robots.txt allows all agents except /world/, but the model page returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare JavaScript challenge ('Enable JavaScript and cookies to continue') to both the page-reading tool and a plain HTTP client. The 2026-08-17 'available' status could not be reproduced. The Internet Archive index lists a capture of that page dated 2025-09-12 (HTTP 200); it was not read, because the page-reading tool refuses web.archive.org. Rights remain unknown in both records. 2026-11-05 (owner decision: Internet Archive captures count as provenance evidence): the Wayback capture https://web.archive.org/web/20250912155210/https://www.printables.com/model/1369571-porsche-964-993-center-console-switch-tab (raw HTML, 181,151 bytes, SHA-256 in docs/research/public-3d-asset-archive-licence-pass-2026-11-05.md) was read with a plain HTTP client. Its title names the author 9khil; its embedded page data gives licence id 1, which the same capture names 'Creative Commons — Attribution', with no version. This agrees with the Renn 3D Parts declaration, so the licence is archive-verified and redistribution is attribution_required. The capture also shows the model is a remix of Thingiverse thing 4826642 'Porsche 964 Center' by Naischnotz (CC Attribution), so attribution must name both authors. No model file was downloaded. 2026-11-07: the live primary Printables page was readable in a normal browser and explicitly linked Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). The Files tab lists one STL, 964 tabs; no editable CAD is listed. The page credits 9khil and identifies the Naischnotz Thingiverse 4826642 remix origin. Its spring-clip 94455255700 fit statement is an author claim, not independent dimensional verification. This current primary read supersedes the earlier access failure and unversioned licence conclusion, while retaining the historical archive capture. See docs/research/console-switch-tab-primary-licence-20261107.md. No model file was downloaded or imported.
